rows.description: Grid rows, chosen with the grid picker in edit mode. Defaults to 2.

columns.description: Grid columns, chosen with the grid picker in edit mode. Defaults to 2.

fitVideos.description: Pack preset grids by video shape. In a custom grid, fill each pane, cropping as needed without stretching. Also available in edit mode.

moveWithoutEditing.displayName: Move and resize screens without edit mode
moveWithoutEditing.description: Drag a screen's picture onto another screen to swap or dock it, and drag the edges between screens to resize them, without opening edit mode. Only the mouse pointer changes over an edge.

rightClickOptions.displayName: Right-click a screen for its edit options
rightClickOptions.description: Right-click a screen to open a menu with its flip, rotate, loop, fill and close options, plus the TV mode toggle. When off, right-click opens the browser's menu.

snapDividers.description: Edges dragged between screens stick at eighths of their row or column, including quarters and halves. Hold Shift while dragging to resize freely.

sceneOrder.description: How each pane orders its scenes. Unwatched, Favourites (high ratings and O counts) and Recently added shuffle with a bias toward those scenes; Smart mix alternates favourites with unwatched scenes; Fewer repeats plays recently watched scenes last. Defaults to random.

spreadScenes.description: Avoid playing scenes with the same performer or studio back to back or side by side.

splitScenes.description: Give each pane its own share of the scenes instead of every pane drawing from the whole list.

avoidDuplicates.displayName: Avoid the same scene on several screens
avoidDuplicates.description: Start every screen on a different scene, and skip scenes already playing on another screen when moving to the next one. Going back or choosing a search result can still repeat a scene.

randomStart.description: Jump to a random point when a scene starts.

loopScenes.description: Repeat a scene instead of advancing to the next one.

pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause every pane while the browser tab is hidden.

tvMode.description: Automatically advance each screen to its next video after the chosen playback time.

tvModeDuration.displayName: TV mode duration (seconds) — from 10 to 600 (10 minutes)
tvModeDuration.description: Each video plays up to 10% shorter or longer, so the screens do not all change together. Defaults to 30 seconds.

markerDuration.displayName: Marker length without an end time (seconds)
markerDuration.description: Seconds to play a marker that has no end time. Defaults to 30.

showPerformerNavigation.description: Show a portrait button for each performer on every screen, which moves that screen to the performer's next scene.

showInMenu.description: Show the DirtyMultiscreen button in Stash's top bar. When hidden, the player stays reachable by URL.

recentGrids.description: Autosave the last grids you played in Saved grids as Autosave 1, 2 and so on, newest first, updated while they play. Name one to keep it for good. 0 turns autosave off. Defaults to 5.

otherPluginLists.description: Let another plugin tell the header button which scenes or markers it shows, such as Cherry Pick's For you or DirtyRank's open battle previews. Defaults to known plugins only.

options.label: Known plugins only (Cherry Pick and DirtyRank)

sections.title: Grid
sections.description: Rows and columns are chosen in the player's edit mode.

sections.title: Scenes
sections.description: Which scene each pane plays next.
